review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: Replacing the evidence ID subset check with `if False` bypasses an active validation constraint, allowing previously rejected or guarded inputs to proceed and altering observable system behavior.

review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The original condition `if not set(evidence_ids).issubset(set(proposal.observed_evidence_ids_json)):` performs a subset check and raises/returns an error or takes a branch when evidence_ids are not a subset of the proposal's observed evidence IDs. Replacing this with `if False:` unconditionally skips that branch entirely, meaning the validation logic inside the block will never execute regardless of input. This produces an observable behavioral difference: inputs that previously triggered the guarded branch (e.g., mismatched or missing evidence IDs) will now silently pass through without the expected response, error, or side effect.
